description:
List the URLs of a property that are currently in a given Google Search Console coverage state, across all of its sitemaps. Pass `state` exactly as it appears in get_indexation_summary's by_state (the raw Google coverage state, e.g. "Crawled - currently not indexed", "Discovered - currently not indexed", "Submitted and indexed", "Excluded by 'noindex' tag", "Page with redirect", "Not found (404)", "Soft 404"). Each page returns url, state, last_crawled, google_canonical (Google-selected) vs declared_canonical (page-declared), and discovered_via ("sitemap" or "referring page"). NOTE: days_in_state is always null — Google does not expose when a URL entered its current state, so it cannot be derived. Cursor-paginated: pass the returned next_cursor to fetch the next page (limit defaults to 50, max 200). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties. Returns feature_not_available when the property's plan does not include Indexation.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// URLs Google crawled but has not indexed.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","state":"Crawled - currently not indexed","limit":50}
```
name: list_indexation_pages
title: Pages by index state
